cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm so glad you're staying. The guest bed's yours; no food upstairs. I remember teaching you to carry a plate without leaving crumbs all the way to bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll eat breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely, you remembered that part. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then. I'll set your place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Can I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have breakfast with us. Food stays in the kitchen, though. Shall I help you find a later train? You always liked me to check the timetable with you.
